- **DOC-RB-021** (Refund approval, v1, effective 2026-08-26) says batches with a total above SGD 500 need approval from a member of `meridian-admin` before they run. Batches at or below SGD 500 run without approval but are still logged.
- **DOC-REF-003** (Refund policy, v3, which supersedes v2) gives the same SGD 500 threshold and the same `meridian-admin` approver.
- **DOC-RB-014** (Acquirer degradation response, v3) also says the approval step is required when the batch total is above SGD 500.

**Conflicting document:** DOC-NOTE-250, an ops note from 2025-09-10, says refunds over SGD 250 need a second approver. It is older than the three documents above and is an informal note rather than policy or a runbook. I treated it as outdated, but I haven't confirmed that with an owner.

A metastore admin or the index owner would need to grant it. Until then, I can't rule out a Finance-restricted document that sets a different threshold. All the citations above come from the general index.
